objective: Characterize spatial tissue heterogeneity: identify spatial domains, relate them to histology, find marker genes, and assess slide-level batch effects.

steps.purpose: Remove empty and failing samples (MAD rule, per slide) and near-empty features before normalising.

alternatives_rejected.reason: failing samples distort normalisation and clustering

steps.purpose: Split every count into a half that finds groups and a half that tests them, so markers are not tested on the data that defined the groups.

alternatives_rejected.option: test markers on the same counts
alternatives_rejected.reason: double dipping: groups found in the data always look different in the same data
the groups would have to be predicted on new samples first, and neighbours leak in space

steps.purpose: Normalise depth on the fit half (log or Pearson residuals, chosen by remaining depth signal) and keep variable features chosen within each slide.

alternatives_rejected.reason: library sizes differ, so depth would dominate every comparison
features differing only between slides would be picked

steps.purpose: Reduce the normalised features to the principal components that exceed their permutation null.

alternatives_rejected.reason: noise in thousands of features swamps structure

steps.purpose: Measure how strongly slides separate the samples, within each patient, and how batches coincide with 'label' (report only).

alternatives_rejected.reason: patient differences are biology as well as technique

steps.purpose: A count VAE conditioned on slide as a non-linear correction candidate next to Harmony and ComBat.

alternatives_rejected.reason: a conditioned count model can remove non-linear batch effects and residual depth signal

steps.purpose: Compare Harmony, ComBat, the count VAE and no correction for slide effects; keep the best mixing that preserves within-slide neighbourhoods (label-free; label silhouette reported only).

alternatives_rejected.reason: patient mixing is 0.004; domains would stay confined to single patients and markers with patient replicates would be untestable

steps.purpose: Screen pretrained encoders on patient-held-out pairs and extract histology image features, with stain normalisation decided from the measured colour differences.

alternatives_rejected.reason: the best encoder depends on the image domain

steps.purpose: Find spatial domains: features joined with their neighbourhood mean (BANKSY-style), number of domains chosen by subsample stability and spatial coherence.

alternatives_rejected.reason: ignores that neighbouring samples share a domain (100% of variable features autocorrelated)
the data, not a preset, decide how fine

steps.purpose: Compare the discovered domains with the histological annotation 'label' (validation only: never used to choose).
Depth-normalise all QC-passed counts, keeping essentially every detected feature, so spatial-variability tests are not driven by spatially varying library size.

alternatives_rejected.reason: PC1 tracks depth (rho 0.99 raw) and depth varies within tissue, so raw counts would flag depth patterns as spatially variable genes
it holds only 2,000 features and half the counts

steps.purpose: Find spatially variable features (Moran's I within slides, BH FDR, permutation calibration) on depth-normalised counts; the test does not use the discovered groups.
Test which domains border each other more or less often than chance (label permutations within slides).
How well histology image features alone predict the discovered domains under patient-grouped cross-validation; the expression arm is a ceiling reference only.

alternatives_rejected.reason: the objective relates domains, not annotations, to histology; 'label' is reserved for validation

steps.purpose: Marker genes per domain: patient pseudobulk, paired moderated t-test, BH FDR, on the held-out half of the counts; the naive per-sample test is reported for comparison.

alternatives_rejected.reason: samples of one patient are not independent (1,702 per patient)
slides are nested in patients; the patient is the independent unit

steps.purpose: A two-dimensional map of the corrected representation for the report, method chosen by trustworthiness and stability.

notes: In 'histology' the expression arm ('other') is circular because domains were found from that embedding; only the image-alone balanced accuracy against chance is interpreted as the histology association.
Domains found in only one or two patients cannot be tested with min_replicates 3; such domains are reported as patient-specific rather than forced into marker tests.
Declared costs (largest: multimodal_features ~875 s, generative_batch_vae ~270 s, dimreduce_map ~200 s) sum well below the 10,800 s total budget.
